description.value: Lemon Creek Pioneer Campground is a small, tranquil campground in the Slocan Valley near Winlaw, BC, offering 26 well-groomed sites arranged in a horseshoe layout with a mix of serviced RV spots and treed tent sites with firepits. Its non-commercial, secluded atmosphere lends itself to extended stays, and the grounds sit within walking distance of the historic Japanese Internment Garden and the Lemon Creek Confluence. It is a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the Frog Peak Loop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides clear evidence for multiple amenities. Key confirmations: showers and indoor washrooms from 'indoor washrooms and hot showers'; potable water from '10 of those are serviced with water and power'; covered shelter from 'Covered Gazebo'; reservations accepted via online form and phone (250-355-2547 confirmed on both reservations and campground subpages). No street address is provided on the website or in OSM tags. The most recent blog post is dated May 2019, suggesting the site may not be actively maintained, but the reservation form and contact info remain present.
concerns: Most recent website blog post is dated May 2019; site may not be actively maintained, though contact info and reservation form remain present.
Minor site count discrepancy: front page lists 9 RV sites with 15/30 amp service, but campground subpage states 10 sites are serviced with water and power.
No street address found in OSM tags or on website.
OSM record has no osm_id and empty osm_tags; record appears to be manually added with minimal OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating campground on the Frog Peak Loop with confirmed amenities and active reservation system. Clearly useful to touring cyclists.
